   752	10.4.1 Adjust Outcast.Look at the cards in the Lost Souls pile, ignoring birds. The suit with the most cards becomes the new Outcast—move the outcast marker, showing its Outcast side, to that suit. If that suit was already the Outcast, flip the marker to Hated. If no one suit had the most cards, the marker stays on its current suit and, if it is not Hated, flips to its Hated side.
   753	
   754	10.4.2 Discard Lost Souls.Discard all of the cards in the Lost Souls pile to the discard pile. *(Dominance cards become available to take.)*
   755	
   756	10.4.3 Perform Conspiracies.You can spend acolytes, returning them to your supply, to perform conspiracies in clearings matching the Outcast, in any order and number, as follows. If the Outcast is Hated, the conspiracy costs one fewer acolyte.
   757	
   758	**Q:**Can I use Convert or Sanctify to only remove a warrior or building, but not place my own warrior or building there?
   759	
   760	**A:**Nope! The rule says that “you must complete the conspiracy,” and faction rules overrule general rules if you cannot fulfill them both.
   761	
   762	1. Crusade.Spend two acolytes to initiate a battle in an Outcast clearing or to move *(at least one warrior)* from an Outcast clearing and then, if you wish, initiate a battle in the destination clearing.
   763	2. Convert.Spend two acolytes to replace an enemy warrior from an Outcast clearing with a Cult warrior. *(To replace a piece, you must be able to remove the old piece and place the new piece.)*
   764	3. Sanctify.Spend three acolytes to replace an enemy building from an Outcast clearing with a garden of the Outcast suit.
   765	
   766	10.5Daylight
   767	
   768	You may reveal any number of cards and perform one ritual per card revealed, in any order and number, as follows. *(Reveal cards from your hand into your play area. They cannot be used for any other purposes during Daylight.)*
   769	
   770	10.5.1 Build.In a clearing you rule matching the revealed card, place a garden whose printed suit matches the clearing suit.
   771	
   772	10.5.2 Recruit.In a clearing matching the revealed card, place a warrior.
   773	
   774	10.5.3 Score.Spend the same card you reveal *(placing in Lost Souls)* to score the victory points listed above the rightmost empty Gardens space of the suit matching the revealed card. You cannot Score if no gardens of that suit are on the map. You may perform this only once per turn per suit.
   775	
   776	10.5.4 Sacrifice.Place a warrior in the Acolytes box. To perform this ritual, you must reveal a bird card.
   777	
   778	10.6Evening
   779	
   780	Your Evening has three steps in the following order.
   781	
   782	10.6.1 Return Revealed Cards.Return all cards you revealed this turn to your hand.
   783	
   784	10.6.2 Craft.You may craft by activating gardens whose printed suit matches the Outcast suit.
   785	
   786	10.6.3 Draw and Discard.Draw one card, plus one card per uncovered draw bonus. Then, if you have more than five cards in your hand, discard cards of your choice until you have five.
   787	
   788	11.Riverfolk Company
   789	
   790	11.1Overview
   791	
   792	When news arrived that the Woodland on the shore of the great lake was descending into all-out war, the Riverfolk Company quickly dispatched its officers to set up shop. As other factions purchase their services, the Riverfolk can further entrench their commercial interests by establishing trade posts along the river, scoring victory points. So too can they score points by raw accumulation of funds, but a big treasury makes for an easy target, so the Riverfolk must take care in expanding their operations across the dangerous forest.
   793	
   794	11.2Faction Rules and Abilities
   795	
   796	11.2.1 Crafting.The Riverfolk craft during Daylight by committing funds to empty spaces on the Trade Posts tracks. *(They have no crafting pieces.)*
   797	
   798	11.2.2 Swimmers.The Riverfolk treat rivers as paths and may move along a river fully linking an origin and destination clearing, ignoring the need for rule. *(They can still move using paths.)*
   799	
   800	11.2.3 Public Hand.The Riverfolk place their hand face up above their faction board. *(If a random card is taken from the Riverfolk, the cards are flipped face down, shuffled, drawn from, and then flipped face up.)*
"}

   802	11.2.4 Funds.To take many actions, the Riverfolk commit and spend funds: warriors in their Funds box.
   803	
   804	11.2.5 Trade Posts.The Riverfolk score victory points when they place trade posts.
   805	
   806	1. Trade Disruption.Whenever a trade post is removed, the Riverfolk remove half of their funds, rounded up, and remove the trade post from the game permanently.
   807	
   808	11.2.6 Buying Services.At the start of another player's Birdsong, that player may buy Riverfolk services.
   809	
   810	**Q:**Can I not consent to the action of another player?
   811	
   812	**A:**Nope, there are no actions in Root that require consent. For example, the Vagabond does not require consent to form a coalition with someone or Aid someone, and a player does not need the Riverfolk's consent to buy services from them.
   813	
   814	**Q:**Can the Riverfolk refuse to sell you one of their services?
   815	
   816	**A:**Nope! As long as you pay the cost, you get the service.
   817	
   818	1. Cost.The buyer must place warriors from their supply into the Riverfolk's Payments box equal in number to the cost of that service listed on the Riverfolk's Services track.
   819	2. Number of Services.Each turn, a player may buy one service plus one per clearing with a trade post and their faction pieces.
   820	3. Vagabond Funds.The Vagabond pays for services by exhausting items—for each item he exhausts to do so, the Riverfolk place one Riverfolk warrior in the Payments box.
   821	
   822	11.2.7 Riverfolk Services.The Riverfolk offer three services, as follows.
   823	
   824	**Q:**When I hire Riverfolk mercenaries, can I start a battle with them even if I don't have pieces in the clearing where I'm battling?
   825	
   826	**A:**Go for it! Plus, if you don't have any warriors there, there's no one to split hits with.
   827	
   828	**Q:**Can Riverfolk Mercenaries be used to battle hirelings controlled by the Riverfolk?
   829	
   830	**A:**Yes! Mercenaries just won't battle against the Riverfolk themselves, not controlled hirelings.
   831	
   832	1. Hand Card.The buyer takes any card from the Riverfolk's hand and adds it to their hand. *(The buyer may buy this service multiple times as long as they have access to enough trade posts.)*
   833	2. Riverboats.The buyer treats rivers as paths until the end of their turn.
   834	3. Mercenaries.During Daylight and Evening of this turn, except when battling the Riverfolk, the buyer treats Riverfolk warriors as their own for rule and for battle. *(The buyer cannot move them, count them toward dominance, or remove them except by taking hits. They are no longer enemy pieces, but they are still Riverfolk faction pieces, so they cannot be affected by abilities such as the Marquise's Field Hospitals or used in actions such as the Duchy's Sway Ministers.)*
   835	   1. Taking Hits.The buyer must split hits, taking odd hits by removing owned *(not Riverfolk)* warriors, if any, or owned buildings or tokens only if they have no warriors *(including Riverfolk)* in the clearing of battle.
   836	   2. Vagabond & Mercenaries.The Vagabond cannot buy Riverfolk Mercenaries. If Riverfolk Mercenaries are removed in a battle against the Vagabond, the Vagabond does not become Hostile with the Riverfolk.
   837	
   838	11.3Faction Setup
   839	
   840	11.3.1 Step 1: Gather Warriors.Form a supply of 15 warriors.
   841	
   842	11.3.2 Step 2: Place Warriors.Place 4 warriors in any clearings touching the river.
   843	
   844	11.3.3 Step 3: Fill Trade Posts Tracks.Place 9 trade posts on the matching spaces of your Trade Posts tracks.
   845	
   846	11.3.4 Step 4: Gain Starting Funds.Place 3 warriors in your Payments box.
   847	
   848	11.3.5 Step 5: Set Starting Prices.Place 1 service marker on any space of each of your Services tracks.
   849	
   850	11.4Birdsong
"}
